snapshotCaveat: The target lists are evidence from this saved backend report, not a claim that concurrently edited canonical content/views were the exact inputs of that run. Counts and country signatures are bound to this report hash. Integration must rerun actual backend projection, source-fidelity, exclusivity and liveness checks on its exact final tree.
selectionPolicy: Candidate-only evidence; no targetViewIds installation manifest is issued.
Exclude a profile already targeting the unchanged original task.
A proposed factor must exactly match the profile target signature: space-only, cone-only, or combined; select at most one family member.
Never use a generic or merged viewId alone when different countries represented by it have different target signatures.
Target membership is not official curriculum source proof. All placements require independent current source review; SH profiles are explicitly held pending it.
No ordinary fallback anchors, artificial prerequisites, runtime title matching or target inference are authorized.
